source_support_contract.base: the existing 8-view signed silhouette intersection field F4_SOURCE_FIELD, where the maximum signed 2D silhouette distance is negative only inside every admitted silhouette extrusion
source_support_contract.semantics: SOURCE_ABSENT is separate from PROVEN_EMPTY; source-support clipping does not prove the learned field has no zero outside the envelope, it declares such zero-set content inadmissible under the product source contract
source_support_contract.required_padding: at least the frozen camera/calibration and raster edge tolerance; exact padding must be recorded before any production use
source_support_contract.first_diagnostic: coarse visual-hull AABB and exact source-field support are both reported; only exact source-field support may justify final clipping

learned_field_lattice_audit.grid: the exact 189^3 vertex lattice defining all 188^3 X6C micro2 cells
learned_field_lattice_audit.population: all cells with direct learned-field corner min < 0 and max > 0
learned_field_lattice_audit.gate: zero cells may simultaneously have a C0 strict-positive or strict-negative enclosure
learned_field_lattice_audit.note: This uses the learned IRIS field itself. NB1 source-hull MC_R512 is explicitly forbidden as a learned-field certificate oracle.

metrics: affine variance lower and upper bounds before LayerNorm reciprocal-sqrt
source-support class and source-surface distance proxy
layernorm_instrumentation.interpretation: Direct center sigma alone cannot establish LayerNorm blow-up; the affine variance interval must be inspected.
